technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Implement Scala-based Spark streaming module deployment via Spring XD's module plugin/extension mechanism, using a dedicated module classloader that bundles the Scala library and Spark dependencies so Scala-compiled modules resolve correctly at deploy time.
U1: Target Spark 1.x with Scala 2.10 compatibility (matching the Spring XD 1.1.x era) and package the sample as a standard XD module archive.
U2: Add a new 'Troubleshooting' section to the project wiki documenting the recommended ulimit (-n) of 10K, including the 'Too many open files' deployment exception as the rationale.
U3: Change the log pattern layout in xd-container-logger.properties to include the date, and apply the same change to admin/single-node logger properties for consistency.
U4: Launch Kafka Server as a separate JVM process during tests (process start/stop management, dynamic free-port selection, shutdown hooks for cleanup) instead of an in-JVM embedded broker.
U6: Externalize broker connection settings (host/port) via system properties/environment so the same tests can run against an externally managed broker, with CI configuration updated accordingly.

U5: Modify publish-maven.gradle to load versions (e.g., Spring Boot, hadoop-common) from dependencies.properties using a Gradle Properties load, injecting them into generated POMs instead of hardcoded values.
U7: Use the existing SonarQube dashboard to triage violations; fix genuine issues in code and mark false positives/not-applicable items as 'False positive'/'Won't fix' in Sonar.
U8: Implement the Spark batch job sample as a standard XD batch module (e.g., distributed word count) with its own Gradle build, packaged and documented like other samples.
assumptions: A single developer performs all work; estimates are effort in workdays (1 workday = 8 hours), not calendar duration.
Work targets the existing Spring XD 1.1.x codebase with its Gradle build, existing Kafka test suite, and existing Spark module support infrastructure.
Spark 1.x / Scala 2.10 and Hadoop 2.x are the compatible technology versions for U1 and U8.
U4 and U6 are related but distinct stories; the shared process-launch test infrastructure is estimated once under U4, and U6 only covers external-broker configuration, migration, and CI updates.
A SonarQube server and current violation report already exist; the violation volume is moderate (tens of issues) and the same developer triages and fixes them.
A writable project wiki exists for U2; no formal documentation review process is required.
CI environments can host or reach an external Kafka broker for U6.
Estimates include implementation, unit/integration testing, and related documentation updates, but exclude release management, packaging for release, and long-running soak tests.
No changes are required in other Spring projects; scope is limited to the spring-xd repository and its wiki.
